Cross-faction is a term used for features that allow players from the opposite factions (Alliance and Horde) to group up. There are several features that are now cross-faction, however with some limits, which include: Communities, Guilds, Groups, and Instances.

Cronies are crowd pummelers summoned during The Underpin encounter. They are summoned via the which summons three Cronies on Tier ?, five on Tier ??. Attacking them isn't ideal due to the amount of health they have and their constant cannon attacks. Instead, kick the Time Bombs summoned by into them by interaction and facing the bomb towards their direction. The time bombs will do AoE and damage multiple near each other. The Crumbling Cliffs are a series of cliffs and valleys in the northern Waking Shores, located between Uktulut Backwater and Uktulut Pier. The eastern cliff features stone outcrops and lava pits, as well as agitated earth elementals which have been attacking the nearby Conservatory Outpost. The remainder of the area is a lush collection of valleys, home to thunder lizards, turtles, and proto-dragons. On one plateau is a treehouse containing several kite enthusiasts and a jug of Slam Bam Swill.

Cryptozoic Entertainment is a publisher of board games, trading cards, and collectibles. Founded in March 2010, the company focuses on licensed and original properties across entertainment and gaming franchises, including World of Warcraft. Cryptozoic acquired the World of Warcraft Trading Card Game license on 24 March 2010 after Upper Deck's departure. Its first release, Wrathgate, continued established mechanics with content aligned to . Over three years, they published twelve sets across the Scourgewar, Worldbreaker, Aftermath, and Timewalkers blocks. Core gameplay features, including loot cards and cooperative raid formats, remained active through organized play support. The Timewalkers:

Cuffs of the Primal Leywarden can be obtained by converting another pair of Midnight Season 2 cloth bracers using the Catalyst. They are part of the Primal Leywarden's Attire set but are not required to benefit from the tier bonus.
Crystallized Dawnlight Manaflux is an achievement reward from Midnight Season 1: Champion of the Dawn. It contains an Dawnlight Manaflux charge for the catalyst.
Crystallized Venomblight Manaflux is an achievement reward from Midnight Season 2: Serpent Scion. It contains an Venomblight Manaflux charge for the catalyst.
The Crystalized Steelshard is an earth elemental found at the Cindershard Seam in the Waking Shores.
The Crystalline Construct is a crystal elemental found in the Azure Span during Cataloging the Azure Span.
Curiously-Shaped Stomach can be acquired by skinning creatures in zones and instances. There is a small chance per creature skinned to gain one.
